info.name: Helpdesk API
info.description:
Multi-tenant helpdesk API (v1). Run against the `demo` profile (Acme + Globex seed data).

Run in order: the Auth folder logs in as every demo role and stores the tokens in collection variables. The "Tenant isolation" folder logs in as Globex and proves Acme resources are invisible (404).

CLI: `npx newman run postman/helpdesk.postman_collection.json`

item.name: Tenant isolation
item.description: Globex users try to reach Acme resources. Every request must return 404 (or 400 for cross-tenant assignment) — never data.

item.name: Globex agent lists only Globex tickets
Acme agent assigns to Globex agent → 400
